description: Org-wide Renovate preset. Repos extend with: github>monumental-archive/.github#vX.Y.Z

packageRules.description: Routine updates merge themselves once aged and green; majors always get a human.

First-party canon skips the age gate: it models third-party supply-chain risk, and applied to our own repo — gated by our own CI — it only guarantees every consumer runs a week-stale canon (#133, the v0.16.1 VSA failure).

customManagers.description: lefthook remote hooks pin a canon tag; lefthook.yml has no native manager for the ref line (#133).
The shared-preset reference pins a canon tag; extends: has no native manager for the #tag suffix (#133).
